errorMessages.missing_bearer_token: The request has no Conv2pdf API key.
errorMessages.invalid_api_key: The Conv2pdf API key is invalid or has been revoked. Create a key in the Developer tab of your Conv2pdf dashboard and update the connection.
errorMessages.account_not_provisioned: This API key has no Conv2pdf API plan. Choose one at https://conv2pdf.com/en/api/pricing/
errorMessages.quota_exceeded: The Conv2pdf quota of this API key is used up. Paid plans renew it every month, the Dev trial does not. Plans: https://conv2pdf.com/en/api/pricing/
errorMessages.credits_expired: The Conv2pdf trial credits have expired. Choose a plan to keep converting: https://conv2pdf.com/en/api/pricing/
errorMessages.rate_limited: Conv2pdf accepts 20 conversions per minute per API key.
errorMessages.server_busy: The Conv2pdf conversion queue is full.
errorMessages.file_too_large: The file is larger than your Conv2pdf plan allows: 10 MB per file on the Dev plan, 200 MB on paid plans. Plans: https://conv2pdf.com/en/api/pricing/
errorMessages.plan_limit_files: Your Conv2pdf plan does not merge that many files at once: 2 on the Dev plan, up to 20 on paid plans. Plans: https://conv2pdf.com/en/api/pricing/
errorMessages.too_many_files: Conv2pdf merges up to 20 PDFs at a time.
errorMessages.unsupported_content: The file does not match this module. Conv2pdf checks the content of the file, not only its name.
errorMessages.unsupported_media_type: Conv2pdf does not accept this type of file for this module.
errorMessages.source_unreadable: Conv2pdf could not read this file.
errorMessages.password_protected: The file is protected with a password. For a PDF, remove it first with the Remove a password from a PDF module. A DRM-protected e-book or a locked iWork document cannot be converted.
errorMessages.needs_password: The PDF asks for a password to open. Fill in the PDF password field, or remove it first with the Remove a password from a PDF module.
errorMessages.wrong_password: The password of the PDF is wrong.
errorMessages.password_too_short: The password must be at least 6 characters long.
errorMessages.password_too_long: The password must be 64 characters or fewer.
errorMessages.pdf_already_protected: This PDF is already protected with a password.
errorMessages.pdf_not_protected: This PDF has no password to remove.
errorMessages.pdf_scanned_needs_ocr: This PDF is a scan without text, so it cannot be converted to Word.
errorMessages.pdf_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages for this module.
errorMessages.too_many_pages: The document has too many pages for this module.
errorMessages.invalid_page_range: Invalid page range. Use page numbers and ranges, for example 1-5,7,10-12.
errorMessages.unsupported_characters: The watermark text contains characters that cannot be rendered.
errorMessages.output_too_large: The result is too large to be delivered.
errorMessages.conversion_failed: Conv2pdf could not process this file. Failed conversions do not count against your quota.
errorMessages.conversion_timeout: The conversion took too long and was stopped. Failed conversions do not count against your quota.
errorMessages.file_expired: The converted file is no longer available on Conv2pdf.
errorMessages.job_deleted: The conversion was deleted on Conv2pdf before it could be downloaded.
errorMessages.job_not_found: Conv2pdf does not know this conversion.
errorMessages.tool_not_found: Conv2pdf does not have this tool.
errorMessages.payload_too_large: The request is larger than Conv2pdf accepts: 220 MB for the files and fields together.
errorMessages.too_many_parts: The request has too many parts: Conv2pdf accepts 20 files and 10 fields at most.
errorMessages.field_required: A required field is empty, such as the pages to extract or the watermark text.
errorMessages.invalid_rotation: The rotation is not one Conv2pdf accepts: 90, 180 or 270.
errorMessages.invalid_quality: The quality is not one Conv2pdf accepts: low, medium or high.
errorMessages.invalid_format: The format is not one Conv2pdf accepts for this module.
errorMessages.unsupported_format: Conv2pdf cannot read this image format. Use a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or TIFF image.
errorMessages.epub_blank_output: This e-book cannot be converted: its pages are full-screen images (comics, picture books, manga), and their layout does not survive the conversion to PDF.
errorMessages.epub_too_long: The e-book is longer than the 1,500 pages Conv2pdf converts at once.
errorMessages.pdf_single_page: This PDF has a single page: there is nothing to split.
errorMessages.ps_blank_output: This PostScript file draws no page: a file that only holds a font or a library of procedures, or whose program fails, produces none.
errorMessages.html_blank_output: This HTML file prints as a blank page: nothing in it is drawn when printed. It may be empty, or hide its content for printing.
errorMessages.invalid_url: This web page address cannot be converted.
errorMessages.url_unreachable: The web page could not be reached. Check the address, and that the site is online and public.
errorMessages.url_http_error: The web page answered with an error. Check that the address opens in a browser without signing in: Conv2pdf opens the page without a session.
errorMessages.url_blocked: The web page leads to a private network address: Conv2pdf only opens public web pages, and the page or one of its redirects points to a private or local network.
errorMessages.url_blank_page: The web page prints as a blank page: its content may need a login, or be hidden for printing.
errorMessages.no_file_expected: Convert a web page to PDF takes the address of a page, not a file.

urlCauses.malformed: Write the full address, starting with https:// or http://.
urlCauses.scheme: Only http and https addresses can be converted.
urlCauses.credentials: Remove the user name and password from the address: Conv2pdf opens the page without signing in.
urlCauses.private_address: Conv2pdf only opens public web pages, not addresses of a private or local network.
urlCauses.local_name: Conv2pdf only opens public web pages, not names of a local network.

contentHints.epub: This file is an EPUB e-book: use the Convert an e-book to PDF module.
contentHints.xps: This file is an XPS document: use the Convert an XPS document to PDF module.
contentHints.postscript: This file is PostScript or EPS: use the Convert a PostScript file to PDF module.
contentHints.html: This file contains a web page, not the expected document. Map the file itself: a share or preview link returns the page that displays the file. To convert an HTML file, use the Convert an HTML file to PDF module.
contentHints.iwork_numbers: This file is a Numbers spreadsheet, which Conv2pdf does not convert. Open it in Numbers and choose File > Export To > PDF.
contentHints.iwork_keynote: This file is a Keynote presentation, which Conv2pdf does not convert. Open it in Keynote and choose File > Export To > PDF.
contentHints.iwork: Conv2pdf converts Apple Pages documents only, named with their .pages extension.
